c085.title: The Kyiv Marathon
c085.story: Anna loves [[jogging]] in the park every morning. She checks her speed on her new fitness [[tracker]]. In May, she runs her first race in Kyiv. At the [[start]], she feels nervous but happy. Fast [[runners|runner]] go past her in a quick [[sprint]]. Max says some of them do [[cross-country]] and [[triathlon]] too. Anna runs slowly, but she does not stop. At the end, a [[champion]] from Lviv waves to everyone. This young [[athlete]] stands on the [[podium]]. She gets a gold [[medal]] and a big [[prize]]. Journalists ask another [[medalist]] questions about [[doping]]. Anna has no medal, but she is very proud.

c086.title: Taras Learns Karate
c086.story: Taras is Anna's little brother, and he starts [[karate]] this month. His [[dojo]] is near his school. His [[sensei]] has a black belt and a fifth [[dan]]. She also teaches [[kung fu]] on weekends. Every Friday, the kids do [[sparring]] in pairs. At home, Taras watches [[sumo]] on TV with Dad. One day, he meets a young [[gymnast]] from the next hall. She can do a perfect split, and Taras wants to try. Now he practices kicks and splits every day.

c087.title: Boxing Night
c087.story: On Saturday night, Max invites his friends over to watch sports on TV. First they see a famous [[boxer]] win easily, and then the [[MMA]] event begins. The young [[challenger]] is clearly the [[underdog]], and nobody expects him to win. The main [[fight]] starts badly for him, and he falls in the first round. But this [[fighter]] does not give up, and slowly he makes a [[comeback]]. In the third round, he hits the [[champ]] hard and wins by [[knockout]]. The [[commentator]] screams so loudly that Max's cat runs under the sofa. The fans in the hall are in total [[euphoria]], and so are Max's friends. Later, they watch the [[highlights|highlight]] again and again until midnight. Max says, "Tomorrow I'm going to the gym!"

c088.title: Basketball After School
c088.story: Taras plays [[basketball]] for his school team. One Monday, the coach shows the [[roster]] for the next game. Taras sees his name on it and smiles. It is a [[playoff]] game against a strong [[opponent]]. In the first half, a [[teammate]] makes a great [[dunk]]. Then Taras gets the [[rebound]] and makes an [[assist]]. The other team scores fast, so the coach calls a [[time-out]]. After that, Taras's team plays better and wins. Next week, they also win the [[final]]! It is a real [[triumph]] for the whole school. The school [[mascot]], a big blue bear, dances on the court. Both teams shake hands, because the coach loves [[fair play]].

c089.title: A Day at the Ocean
c089.story: Max and Anna spend their summer vacation by the [[ocean]]. On the first day, they try [[surfing]] and [[SUP]]. A friendly [[surfer]] shows them his light [[fiberglass]] [[surfboard]]. Then they rent a [[kayak]] for two hours. The next morning, they go [[diving]] with a [[diver]] named Oleh. From the water, they see a small boat near the shore. Its [[keel]] hits a [[buoy]], but nobody is hurt. Above the beach, people are [[skydiving]] with colorful parachutes. In the evening, Max and Anna play [[volleyball]] on the sand. Anna wins, and Max says she is just lucky. Tired and happy, they eat ice cream and watch the sunset.

c090.title: Boards and Bikes
c090.story: Taras and his friends love extreme sports and [[hip-hop]]. After school, they go [[skateboarding]] in the park. Taras rides a new [[skateboard]] from his grandma. On Saturday, they take their [[mountain bikes|mountain bike]] to the forest. The bikes have light [[composite]] frames. They ride on a long [[trail]] near the river. Taras loves [[biking]], but in winter he prefers [[snowboarding]]. His friends also play [[hockey]], [[frisbee]] and [[paintball]]. One evening, they invite Anna to join them. Anna laughs and says, "I want something calm." So everyone goes [[bowling]], and Anna wins every game!

c091.title: An American Sports Weekend
c091.story: In October, Max flies to Texas to visit his friend Jake. On Friday night, they watch [[baseball]] at a small local stadium. In the last [[inning]], a young player hits a [[home run]], and everyone jumps up. On Saturday, Jake takes him to an American football game at his old high school. The [[quarterback]] throws the ball far, and a big [[linebacker]] falls on the grass. Then the home team scores a [[touchdown]] and later a [[field goal]]. The [[cheerleaders|cheerleader]] dance and jump, and Max finds their [[cheerleading]] amazing. On Sunday, they go to a [[rodeo]], where cowboys ride wild horses. After that, they watch Jake's sister play [[lacrosse]] in the park. Her friends invite Max to try [[softball]], and he misses every ball. Max laughs and says that sports at home feel much easier.

c092.title: A Day at the Golf Club
c092.story: Max's rich uncle Victor invites him to his [[golf club]] on Sunday. Max has never played [[golf]], so he feels a little nervous. A friendly [[caddie]] carries their heavy bags across the green grass. While they walk, Uncle Victor talks about [[tennis]] and his trip to a [[grand slam]] final. He also loves [[polo]], [[rugby]] and especially [[cricket]]. He explains that in that game a [[bowler]] throws the ball at the wickets. Max tries his first shot, but the ball flies straight into the lake. Everyone laughs, including Max himself. On the way home, Max says, "Next time, let's just play [[badminton]] in the yard."

c093.title: Max's Band
c093.story: Max loves [[rock]], and he plays [[bass]] in a [[band]] with friends. This month, they want to try [[heavy metal]]. Every evening, they practice in Max's garage. The [[drummer]], Ihor, keeps a fast [[rhythm]]. The [[guitarist]], Sofia, tunes her [[instrument]] very carefully. Their [[frontman]], Dima, cannot find the right [[tone]] for a new song. He tries again and again, and finally it sounds great. On Sunday, they record their first [[demo]] on a phone. Max sends it to Anna, and she says it's loud but cool.

c094.title: Concert Night
c094.story: Anna and Max go to a [[concert]] tonight. It is at the new [[arena]] in Kyiv. All the tickets are [[sold out]]. But Max has two [[premium]] tickets! The band starts with a long [[intro]]. Then they play a [[track]] from the new [[album]]. The guitarist plays a great [[solo]]. The singer has very strong [[vocals|vocal]]. A happy [[groupie]] sings every word. Anna sees the [[tour manager]] near the stage. At the end, Max buys [[merch]] for them. Anna says, "I love a good [[live show]]!"

c095.title: A Summer Music Festival
c095.story: In July, Anna and Max go to a summer music [[festival]]. The [[lineup]] has something for everyone. There is [[rap]], [[R&B]], [[reggae]] and [[electro]]. First, a young [[rapper]] does a [[freestyle]] with the [[MC]]. The crowd shouts and claps to the beat. Later, a [[vocalist]] with a soft voice sings [[world music]]. Anna does not know any of the songs. But by the evening, she has five new favorites. On the way home, she plays them on her phone.

c096.title: Jazz in a Small Club
c096.story: On Friday, Anna's dad takes her to a small [[jazz]] club. It is warm and dark, and it smells of coffee. First, a [[trio]] plays the [[blues]]. Then a [[pianist]] plays a happy [[funk]] song. An old man plays the [[saxophone]] with his eyes closed. A young woman plays the [[bongos|bongo]] next to him. At the end, the band plays the last line in [[unison]]. The music has a great [[groove]], and Anna taps her feet. In the corner, she sees an old [[jukebox]]. Dad puts in a coin, and they dance to one more song.
